mask_policy: reference score set to -100000000000.0 (test.py:135); the query's own source image IS in the gallery and is masked to -10e10 before ranking (test.py:134-135), i.e. excluded by score, not by removal
tie_policy: np.argsort(-sims[i, :]) with numpy default kind='quicksort' (test.py:138). NOT stable: equal scores take an arbitrary positional order, so a query whose target ties with another gallery image is scored by that arbitrary order. target_rank here is the native positional rank; tied_with_target > 0 marks a tie-decided rank
gallery_construction: datasets.FashionIQ.get_test_targets() with gallery_all=False (datasets.py:233-257): the gallery is the order-preserving union of every query's candidate (source) and target image, in first-appearance order -- NOT the full split image list, NOT per-query candidates only
text_path: no text correction anywhere: captions reach the model as '<BOS> {c0} <AND> {c1} <EOS>' (datasets.py:173-175) and are tokenised by the checkpoint's own SimpleVocab (text_model.py:23-27)
transform: Resize(256) -> CenterCrop(224) -> ToTensor -> Normalize(ImageNet 0.485/0.456/0.406, 0.229/0.224/0.225) -- the native FashionIQ val pipeline, train.py:90-96
batch_size_argument_plumbing: params.batch_size, read at test.py:96 (query loop) and test.py:112 (target/gallery loop); the loop flushes at len(imgs) >= params.batch_size. Passed as a SimpleNamespace attribute -- pinned test.py has no CLI, so this is the only argument path, and the checkpoint/pinned files stay byte-identical
